heuristic.purpose: Gameplay-selection heuristic for visual substance; not a scientific classifier.
heuristic.penalties: -4 jump-only, -1.8 for <=2 instructions, -1.4 control-flow-only, -1 trivial glue; score clamped to zero
heuristic.memory_note: Memory counts are derived from x86 operand text; LEA is excluded. Load/store direction is an estimate, while combined memory count is the comparison metric.
heuristic.overlap_note: Histogram intersection of real and bogus richness scores in width-2 bins; 1.0 means fully overlapping distributions and 0.0 means none.
